longDescription:
GRE Math Subject Test prep: practice questions, full-length timed mock tests and interactive simulations of calculus, linear algebra, abstract algebra, real analysis, probability and discrete mathematics. Calcarc follows the GRE Mathematics Test as ETS describes it: about 66 multiple-choice questions in 2 hours 50 minutes, about 50% calculus, 25% algebra and 25% additional topics, with no on-screen calculator. Every answer has a full worked solution and a textbook reference. No account, works offline.

### GRE Math Subject Test Prep
- 478 original practice questions from 77 generators: calculus, algebra (elementary and abstract algebra, linear algebra, number theory) and additional topics, the mix ETS describes
- Numeric answers are computed two independent ways and checked, with a one-line reason for every wrong choice
- A diagnostic and personal plan, spaced review, a mistake notebook and a readiness range after 40 answers
- 6 full-length mock tests: about 66 questions, 170 minutes, free navigation, flag and review grid, no ads while the clock runs

9 SIMULATIONS
Limits (epsilon-delta), derivatives from secant to tangent, integrals as area, Taylor polynomials, series convergence, 2D linear maps with eigenvectors and determinant area, 3D surfaces with gradient, a cyclic group explorer and the binomial distribution. Each ends with a quiz generated from the values you set.

### Solutions And References
- A Full solution sheet on every answer: worked steps, why the other choices fail, the common mistake and a similar question to try
- References for every topic: the ETS exam description and open university textbooks, with the citation always readable offline

### Free To Start
Practice, review, solutions and the basic simulations are free. You start with 2 credits and earn more by watching optional short videos; a credit opens a full mock or the advanced simulation pack. Or go ad-free with the monthly plan ($2.99 per month after a 7-day free trial; renews automatically until cancelled; manage in Google Play), which removes ads. Cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings. If you cancel, you keep ad-free until the end of the period you already paid for, and you will not be charged again. Prefer not to subscribe? Watch short videos to earn credits and unlock features.

### Honest Limits
All questions are original practice material, not real exam questions, and have not been reviewed by a mathematician. Score ranges are rough practice estimates, not predictions. Your progress stays on your device.
